content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations / missing (redlined):**
- **LOL-CAP** — one-way cap at half of amounts paid, our liability unlimited, no carve-outs → mutual 12-month cap plus Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** — only we indemnify, and Article XIII disclaims Licensor IP liability → inserted Licensor indemnity and carved it out of the exclusions.
- **NOSOLICIT** — 3-year, one-way, all-employee non-solicit → mutual, 12 months, personnel involved only.
- **T4C** — 36-month term with no exit for us → added 30-day convenience right with refund.
- **RENEWAL** — 7-year renewal at Licensor's sole option → 12-month mutual renewals with capped uplift.
- **ASSIGN** — blanket assignment bar plus automatic termination on our change of control → affiliate/successor carve-out; CoC trigger removed.
- **IP** — no rights in Licensee-funded customisations, silent on our data → data-ownership sentence and perpetual licence-back.
- **LICENSE** — affiliates/contractors excluded, revocable on any breach → grant extended, cure period added.
- **AUDIT** — no frequency limit (notice and 5% cost-shift are fine) → once per 12 months.
- **WARRANTY** — pure "AS IS" → inserted workmanlike/90-day conformance warranty with remedies.
- **INSURANCE** — absent → standard GL/E&O/cyber covenant inserted.
- **TRANSITION** — absent (one-way return by us in 5 days) → transition assistance and data return inserted.

**Compliant:** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, GOVLAW (New York — preferred), LD, MINCOMMIT.
